_comment: Defaults for collect.py. Command-line options override these. Relative paths are relative to this file; ~ and $VARS are expanded. ideDirs [] = every JetBrains config dir with aia-task-history. copilotHomes [] = $COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot (where the linked Copilot CLI sessions are). pluginDirs [] = ~/.config/github-copilot (GitHub Copilot plugin store). pluginClients: client_name globs of Copilot-plugin sessions. out null = stdout; e.g. "../../reports/intellij.json". Note: a file path here also receives --format tree output unless you pass --out -.
